findings.failing_input: hasSuccessfulRefundTransaction returns true if ANY transaction has empty or 'success' status. Edge case: a refund with 2 txns where one is 'success' (real partial refund) and one is 'failure' (other partial attempt) — currently returns true and deducts the FULL refund_line_items.subtotal. Real partial refunds may need pro-rating by successful transaction amount.
findings.expected: For mixed-success refunds, deduct only the portion corresponding to the successful tx. But the algorithm intentionally IGNORES transactions[].amount (PROBE-EVIDENCE.md §Finding 1), so this can't be fixed without re-introducing the unsafe field.
findings.actual: Works for the common case (all success or all fail). Edge case rare.
findings.fix_sketch: Document the limitation; consider operator-visible alert when transaction-status set is mixed.
findings.regression_test_idea: Refund with 1 success + 1 failure tx; assert deduction is the full refund_line_items.subtotal (current behavior); add comment that this may over-deduct.

findings.fix_sketch: None unless line-level discount data becomes available; would need to add subtraction logic to mirror Apps Script.
